name: Dorian Electra
description: '''Dorian Electra Fridkin Gomberg''' (born June 25, 1992) is an American singer and songwriter. Electra is known for their{{Efn|Electra is [[non-binary]] and uses ''[[they/them]]'' pronouns.<ref name="guardian-12jul2019"/>}} [[Gender nonconformity|non-conforming]] fashion, [[queer aesthetics]], and [[experimental pop]] sound. Their debut studio album, ''[[Flamboyant (album)|Flamboyant]]'', was released in 2019, followed by their second studio album, ''[[My Agenda]]'', in 2020. They released their third studio album, ''[[Fanfare (Dorian Electra album)|Fanfare]]'', in 2023. Electra is [[genderfluid]] and uses ''they/them'' pronouns.
